ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Allcargo Global Limited's Board has approved a change in its financial year to a January 1 to December 31 cycle, primarily to facilitate consolidation with its foreign subsidiaries. This will result in a shortened nine-month financial year for the period commencing April 1, 2026, and ending December 31, 2026, which will temporarily impact year-over-year financial comparability. The move, subject to statutory approvals, appears to be a standard operational streamlining effort and does not present any immediate red flags.
